svg.title: mixdyn against its closest rival on every family
svg.desc: For each of the 38 family-rungs of M3, M4 and M5, mixdyn's plan less the plan of the rival whose 95 % interval reaches highest, in regret per euro of budget, lower better. 37 lie within the non-inferiority margin of 0.05; family 4 at k = 0 does not.
svg.text: mixdyn against its closest rival, family by family
Regret per euro of budget, mixdyn’s plan less the rival’s: mean and paired 95 % interval over the simulated worlds both planned,
for the rival whose interval reaches highest. Left of 0, mixdyn’s plan lost less. The claim is non-inferiority: every interval left of δ.
